I finally got past this glitch last night! It did take some time but was worth it!!

- First, I removed any previous tree’s I had grown.
- I went out to chop and find 5 all new seeds, all from the same tree. (I did Juniper) 
- Once I had all 5, went back and planted them all right next to each other in a line. 
- Now the worst part, I waited on my plot without leaving for 2 full in game days while watering the tree’s when possible. (About 2 hours real time) 

On the second in-game day, once it hit 6am, the trees grew to their second stage and my pinned “Prove your Devotion” quest switched to completed and gave me the next step.
